requirements.summary: Within 60 min of placedAt, allocate and record the order via orders.create with all fields.

requirements.quote: R1.4 A placed order whose id you already recorded is a duplicate: no effect.
requirements.summary: Duplicate placed order must cause no effect.

requirements.quote: - `reject`: cancel the order (R6.1) within **120 min** of `p`, reason `fraud`.

contextText.quote: R2.1 Read `fraud.check` for every new order.

requirements.summary: Fraud reject: cancel order within 120 min of p, reason fraud.

requirements.quote: - `review`: create one human task (R2.2) within **120 min** of `p`.

contextText.quote: R2.1 Read `fraud.check` for every new order.

requirements.summary: Fraud review: create one fraudReview human task within 120 min of p.

requirements.quote: - `reject` before the deadline: cancel the order (R6.1) within **120 min** of the answer, reason `fraud`.

contextText.quote: The analyst has **`fraudReviewHours`** (`rulebook/<edition>/policy.json`) from the creation of the **first** review task for the order.

requirements.summary: Analyst reject before deadline: cancel within 120 min of answer, reason fraud.

requirements.quote: - no usable answer by the deadline: cancel the order (R6.1) **after the deadline** and at the latest **deadline + 120 min**, reason `fraud-review-timeout` (an answer exactly at the deadline still counts).

contextText.quote: The analyst has **`fraudReviewHours`** (`rulebook/<edition>/policy.json`) from the creation of the **first** review task for the order.

requirements.summary: No usable answer by deadline: cancel in (deadline, deadline+120min], reason fraud-review-timeout.

requirements.quote: R3.1 If the allocation has a fulfilment with `available: false` (location `null`), then within **120 min** of the time the order was cleared: set the order to `customerActionRequired` and send `action-required` (§4.8).
requirements.summary: Unavailable fulfilment: within 120 min of clearance set customerActionRequired and send action-required.

requirements.quote: - `amend` at time a: within **60 min** of a, set every unavailable fulfilment `cancelled`; the order then continues with its available fulfilments, **ready** at a (R4).

contextText.quote: The first `amend` or `cancel` for the order whose time is **at or before D** counts (an action exactly at D counts; a timer you set for D does not win against it).

requirements.summary: Counted amend: within 60 min cancel unavailable fulfilments; order ready at a.

requirements.quote: If none is available, cancel the order (R6.1), reason `nothing-available`.
requirements.summary: Amend with no available fulfilment: cancel order with reason nothing-available.

requirements.quote: - `cancel` at time a: cancel the order (R6.1) within **60 min** of a, reason `customer`.
requirements.summary: Counted cancel while waiting: cancel order within 60 min, reason customer.

requirements.quote: - nothing counted by D: **after D** and at the latest **D + 60 min** (the window (D, D + 60 min]) set every fulfilment `cancelled`, set the order `timedOut` and send `order-timed-out`.

contextText.quote: The customer has until the **deadline D = p + `customerActionHours`** (edition at `p`).

requirements.summary: No action by D: in (D, D+60min] cancel fulfilments, set timedOut, send order-timed-out; not at D.

requirements.quote: R4.1 An order with no unavailable fulfilment is **ready** when it is cleared. When an order is ready at time t: set the order `processing` and every available fulfilment `processing`, within **60 min** of t.
requirements.summary: When ready at t, set order and available fulfilments processing within 60 min.

requirements.quote: Nothing about an order (a status, a reservation) is done before the order is recorded (R1.1).
requirements.summary: Order must be recorded before any status or reservation.

requirements.quote: 1. **Reserve** every item of the fulfilment at its location (`inventory.reserve`), within **120 min** of t.

contextText.quote: R4.2 For each available fulfilment, in this order (each step only after the previous step of the same fulfilment has committed):

requirements.summary: Reserve all items within 120 min of ready time t.

requirements.quote: If a batch comes back `partial`, resubmit only the failed items, with their original keys, inside the same window.
requirements.summary: Partial reserve: resubmit only failed items with original keys within window.

requirements.quote: 2. **Charge** the fulfilment's `amountMinor` (`billing.charge`, with the order's `customerId` and `currency`) within **120 min** of the commit of its last reservation.

contextText.quote: R4.2 For each available fulfilment, in this order (each step only after the previous step of the same fulfilment has committed):

requirements.summary: Charge within 120 min of last reservation commit.

requirements.quote: 3. **Ship**: book the shipment (`carrier.create` with the fulfilment's `location`) within **120 min** of the commit of its charge.

contextText.quote: R4.2 For each available fulfilment, in this order (each step only after the previous step of the same fulfilment has committed):

requirements.summary: Book shipment within 120 min of charge commit.

requirements.quote: An error `400` (`invalid-args`, `field-renamed`) means your request was wrong, for example a field a system has renamed (`api/<system>.schema.json` always shows the current names): correct it and re-issue it, with the same key, inside the step's window.
requirements.summary: On 400 error, correct request and reissue with same key within the step's window; not a fulfilment failure.

requirements.quote: - `collected`: set the fulfilment `dispatched` within **120 min** of the message.
requirements.summary: On collected, set dispatched within 120 min.

requirements.quote: - `delivered`: set the fulfilment `completed` within **120 min** of the message; if it was never set `dispatched`, set `dispatched` first (same window, `dispatched` before `completed`).
requirements.summary: On delivered, set completed within 120 min, dispatched first if not set.

requirements.quote: - `collectionFailed`: the fulfilment fails (R5.2).
requirements.summary: collectionFailed makes the fulfilment fail per R5.2.

requirements.quote: R4.5 **Order outcome.** When every fulfilment of a processing order is `completed`, `failed` or `cancelled`, set the order, within **120 min** of the event that ended the last one: `completed` if at least one fulfilment completed, otherwise `failed` if at least one failed, otherwise `cancelled`.
requirements.summary: When all fulfilments ended, set order outcome within 120 min.

requirements.quote: R5.1 **Compensation** of a fulfilment undoes its committed steps in reverse order: cancel its shipment (only if a shipment was booked and not reported `collectionFailed`), then refund its charge (the full `amountMinor`, only if the charge committed), then release each of its reserved items (only items whose reservation committed; the items of one fulfilment in any order).

contextText.quote: A step counts as committed if its result was `ok`, or if its outcome was unknown and `status(key)` shows `committed`.

requirements.summary: Compensate in order: cancel shipment, then refund, then release items; only committed steps.

requirements.quote: Never undo a step that did not commit; never undo a step twice.

contextText.quote: A step counts as committed if its result was `ok`, or if its outcome was unknown and `status(key)` shows `committed`.

requirements.summary: Never undo uncommitted step or undo twice.

requirements.quote: Then, within **120 min** of the failure (the time of the declined or failed attempt, or of the carrier's message): compensate it (R5.1), set it `failed` and send `fulfilment-failed` about the fulfilment.

contextText.quote: A fulfilment **fails** when its charge is declined (`402 card-declined`), when its carrier reports `collectionFailed`, or when one of its steps ends in a permanent error (`retryable: false`) other than an invalid request of yours.

requirements.summary: On fulfilment failure, within 120 min compensate, set failed, send fulfilment-failed.

requirements.quote: Do not retry a permanently failed step.
requirements.summary: Never retry a permanently failed step.

requirements.quote: R6.1 **Cancelling an order** before any of its steps committed: within the rule's window, set every fulfilment that is not `completed`, `failed` or `cancelled` to `cancelled`, set the order `cancelled`, and send `order-cancelled`.
requirements.summary: Cancelling an order: cancel non-ended fulfilments, set order cancelled, send order-cancelled within window.

requirements.quote: If it counts: stop the order.

contextText.quote: A `cancel` for a processing order counts if none of the order's shipments has been reported `collected` at or before the time of the cancel (a collection report in the same instant as the cancel wins).

requirements.summary: Counted cancel during processing stops the order.

requirements.quote: Within **60 min** of the cancel, compensate every fulfilment that is not `completed`, `failed` or `cancelled` (R5.1) and set it `cancelled`; set the order `cancelled`; send `order-cancelled`.
requirements.summary: Within 60 min of counted cancel compensate, cancel fulfilments and order, send order-cancelled.

requirements.quote: A step that commits after the cancel (one already in flight) is compensated within **60 min** of its commit.
requirements.summary: Step committing after cancel is compensated within 60 min of commit.

requirements.quote: Book, charge or reserve nothing new for the order after the cancel.
requirements.summary: No new book, charge or reserve after counted cancel.

requirements.quote: The carrier may collect at any collection time, so cancel a shipment at once.
requirements.summary: Cancel shipment immediately upon counted cancel.

requirements.quote: R6.3 A `cancel` that does not count because a shipment was collected: send `cancel-refused` within **60 min** of the cancel; change nothing else.
requirements.summary: Uncounted cancel due to collection: send cancel-refused within 60 min, nothing else.

requirements.quote: R6.4 A `cancel` for a recorded order that is not yet cleared (its fraud review is open) counts: cancel the order (R6.1) within **60 min** of the cancel, reason `customer`; a later review answer changes nothing.
requirements.summary: Cancel during open fraud review: cancel order within 60 min, reason customer.

requirements.quote: Set each status of an order or fulfilment at most once.

contextText.quote: R7.2 Statuses only move forward: `pending` → `processing` → `dispatched` → `completed` for a fulfilment, with `unavailable`, `cancelled` and `failed` as the other ends; `pending` → (`customerActionRequired`) → `processing` → `completed | failed | cancelled` for an order, with `timedOut` and `cancelled` as the other ends.

requirements.summary: Never set the same status twice for an order or fulfilment.

requirements.quote: Send each required notification exactly once.
requirements.summary: Each required notification sent exactly once, no duplicates.
